Affiliate Disclosure

Last Updated: June 8, 2026

In compliance with Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines, this disclosure details how Bharat Horizon utilizes affiliate referral links to generate operating compensation.

How it Works

When you click on our recommended travel gear blocks (Amazon links), hotel cards (Booking.com links), or flight booking widgets (Skyscanner redirect forms), we may receive a small commission percentage for any successful bookings or purchases made.

No Extra Cost to You

Crucially, clicking these links does NOT increase the pricing you pay. Booking rates, flight deals, and equipment prices remain identical to accessing the services directly. Commissions are paid out of the advertising budgets of our partner platforms.

Editor Integrity

We only recommend products, hotels, and flight aggregators that we trust. Our editorial content regarding state diaries, top 20 places, and itineraries is curated independently of any affiliate compensation agreements.
